correctness.rationale: The verifier exhausts every tournament of orders \(1\) through \(7\), computes \(BA(T)\) from inclusion-maximal transitive subsets and \(UC(T)\) from covering, checks \(BA(T)\subseteq UC(T)\) on every case, and obtains exactly \(13440\) strict order-seven cases. All divergent cases are canonicalized under all \(7!\) relabelings, yielding four classes, and an independent Python implementation verifies the displayed canonical sets.

value.rationale: Order seven is the established first point where the Banks and uncovered solutions separate, making the complete first-disparity layer a natural structural object. The census reveals unexpected rigidity: every strict inclusion adds exactly one uncovered alternative, and the entire labeled layer collapses to four unlabeled classes, one for each feasible choice-set size pair.
